description: This file defines the Affiliate model class for the Opencart e-commerce system, specifically for managing customer affiliate data such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving affiliate records and reports.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Model class for managing customer affiliate data within the Opencart system, providing methods to add, update, delete, and retrieve affiliate information.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Creates a new affiliate record linked to a customer in the database, including optional approval process based on configuration.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Updates existing affiliate record for a specific customer.

methods.name: deleteAffiliate
methods.description: Removes an affiliate record and its related reports from the database.

methods.name: getAffiliate
methods.description: Retrieves the affiliate record associated with a customer, decoding custom field data if present.

methods.name: getAffiliateByTracking
methods.description: Finds an affiliate record using a tracking code.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Logs an affiliate report entry with customer ID, IP address, and country.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all affiliate reports related to a specific customer.
